defs.def: a common bird that lives on or near water and has short legs, webbed feet (= feet with thin pieces of skin between the toes) and a wide beak. There are many types of duck, some of which are kept for their meat or eggs. 鸭

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 每张鸭票所筹的每一美元中，约有98美分直接汇入候鸟保护基金，用于购置湿地和野生动物栖息地，并将其纳入国家野生动物保护区系统——这一事实确保了这片土地将受到保护，并为子孙后代所用。

ex.s: Little wonder the Federal Duck Stamp Program has been called one of the most successful conservation programs ever initiated.
ex.t: 难怪联邦鸭票计划被称为最成功的保护项目之一。

ex.s: These objects have given him ideas for his animal sculptures, such as the famous Rubber Duck.
ex.t: 这些物品为他的动物雕塑，如著名的橡皮鸭，给了他一些想法。

ex.s: This was not only due to fear of sharks, but also finning.
ex.t: 这不仅是因为害怕鲨鱼，还因为取鱼翅的行为。

ex.s: Due to Han Gan’s natural talent and years of hard work, he was eventually chosen to serve Emperor Xuanzong in the royal palace.
ex.t: 由于韩干的天赋和多年努力，他最终被选中在皇宫为唐玄宗服务。

ex.s: Many would become sick, due to the extreme cold and low air pressure, and a few would even lose their lives.
ex.t: 许多人会因为极端寒冷和低气压而生病，少数人甚至会丧命。

ex.s: Under this Act, all waterfowl hunters 16 years of age and over must annually purchase and carry a Federal Duck Stamp.
ex.t: 根据该法案，所有16岁及以上的水禽猎人每年必须购买并携带一张联邦鸭票。

ex.s: The very first Federal Duck Stamp was designed by J.N.
ex.t: 第一枚联邦鸭票是由J.N.设计的。

ex.s: Local festival food: five-coloured sticky rice, duck in lemon sauce, ...
ex.t: 当地节日美食：五彩糯米饭、柠檬酱鸭……

ex.s: The first time I went there, they were living in a small house with dogs, ducks, and another animals.
ex.t: 我第一次去那里时，他们住在一间小屋里，养着狗、鸭子和其他动物。

defs.def: meat from a duck 鸭肉
（表示友好的称呼）乖乖，宝贝儿

ex.s: Duck-billed platypus: The first scientists to examine a preserved platypus body judged it a fake in the late 18th century.
ex.t: 鸭嘴兽：最早检查一只保存完好的鸭嘴兽标本的科学家在18世纪末判定它是一个伪造品。

defs.def: a batsman's score of zero 板球
to move your head or body downwards to avoid being hit or seen 低下头，弯下身（以免被打中或看见）

ex.s: I quickly lower myself, ducking my head to avoid    64    (look) directly into his eyes so he doesn’t feel    65   (challenge).
ex.t: 我迅速蹲下身子，低下头避免____64____（look）直视它的眼睛，以免让它感到____65____（challenge）被挑衅。

defs.def: to avoid sth by moving your head or body out of the way 躲闪；躲避
to move somewhere quickly, especially in order to avoid being seen 迅速行进，飞快行走（以免被看见）
to avoid a difficult or unpleasant duty or responsibility 逃避，回避，推脱，推诿（职责或责任）
to push sb underwater and hold them there for a short time 把 … 按入水中
